run.name: Allison Transmission Holdings Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (ALSN)
run.summary: Allison is a solid mid-leverage industrial credit with a high-margin core, large liquidity and wide covenant headroom, but it still carries acquisition debt of USD 4,037 million and has not shown combined-business leverage. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 2,909 (S1 page:101) less cash 1,495 (S1 page:81) for net; EBITDA is company-defined Adjusted EBITDA 1,130 for FY2025 (S1 page:117); acquired business excluded

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 1,130 over interest paid 120 (S1 page:81); interest received from swaps of 6 is not netted

cash.basis: Cash. Cash S4 page:2, of which 361 is held by foreign subsidiaries (S4 page:44); revolver 1,000 less 4 of letters of credit (S4 page:21); revolver matures January 2031

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Earnings before interest and depreciation cannot be put on a combined basis, and the credit agreement and indentures are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Trailing earnings include the acquired business for only three of four quarters and no pro forma figure exists, so the ratios are overstated relative to a full-year view.
